attchmntText: Airo Lam limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Airo Lam Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published on Sunday, November 08, 2026, in the English Free Press Gujarat and Lokmitra Gujarati newspapers. The filing was signed by Chintan K Mehuriya, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on 09.11.2026.

attchmntText: Airo Lam limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Airo Lam Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held the meeting on 07th November, 2026. The results were reviewed by Chartered Accountants Ashish Sheth & Associates. The auditors issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. The financial statements were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard 34. The company is listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited under the scrip code AIROLAM. The meeting commenced at 04:00 PM and concluded at 05:45 PM. The Company Secretary and Compliance Officer is Chintan K. Mehuriya. The registered office is located in Prantij, Gujarat.

attchmntText: Significant movement in price has been observed in Airo Lam limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, has written to the company. The response from the company is awaited.
